comment: src/modules/Accent.hh:63 turns the knob into an amount of 0.2 to 1.1, and :47 makes the gain envelope * amount + (1 - amount). At the peak of the envelope that is always 1, whatever the knob, so the accented level is the input level; between accents it is 1 - amount, which is 0.8 at the bottom of the knob and -0.1 at the top. The knob therefore only attenuates, and past the point where amount passes 1 (about 89 per cent of the travel) the resting signal is inverted rather than merely quiet. The manual's claim that the control boosts the accented signal is not in the code. The 70ms envelope is at :55.
